description: This file defines the ObjectResetter class which manages resetting a game object to its original position, rotation, and structure within a Unity project. It includes methods for delayed resetting and restoring the object's state, including physics properties.

classes.name: ObjectResetter
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class responsible for resetting an object's position, rotation, and hierarchy to its original state, including handling its Rigidbody physics component.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the original position, rotation, and structure of the object, and retrieves its Rigidbody component for physics manipulation.

methods.name: DelayedReset
methods.description: Starts a coroutine to reset the object after a specified delay.

methods.name: ResetCoroutine
methods.description: Coroutine that waits for the delay duration, then restores the object’s original structure, position, rotation, and physics velocities, and sends a reset message.
